codes.means: the file has no YAML header, so it records no facts about the save
codes.fix: write the header by hand from the standard; stamp never creates one

codes.means: the file name is not YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-slug.md, the name the writer gives every checkpoint
codes.fix: rename it to the save's local time, seconds included, then a slug

codes.means: kind is missing or is not "checkpoint"
the record names no standard, the bare unversioned checkpoint URL written before versions, or another kind's standard
codes.fix: checkpoint-md stamp <dir> --apply adds or upgrades it; a record naming another kind's standard is not a checkpoint, so move or fix it by hand

codes.means: the record names a version of the checkpoint standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install the checkpoint-md version that implements it, or rewrite the record to https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/checkpoint/v1

codes.means: summary is missing or empty: the one line the save is indexed by in SAVE-LOG.md
codes.fix: write summary, one line of at most 120 characters

codes.means: summary is longer than 120 characters, so the SAVE-LOG.md index stops being a line
codes.fix: shorten summary to 120 characters and move the rest into the body

codes.means: the header carries a key the checkpoint standard does not define
codes.fix: move it into the body, or onto one of: kind, standard, date, sha, session, summary, repos, projects, skills, people, urls, tags

codes.means: a value is a nested map; the header is flat, facts never paragraphs
codes.fix: flatten it: repos are written name@sha, one string each

codes.means: a value, or an item of a list, is not a string
codes.fix: write each value as a string, and each list as a list of strings

codes.means: a list key holds a single value, or a single-value key holds a list
codes.fix: repos, projects, skills, people, urls and tags are lists ([] when empty); every other key is one value

codes.means: a single value runs over one line or past 400 characters
codes.fix: keep it to one line; a paragraph belongs in the body

codes.means: an entry in projects or people is not a kebab-case slug
codes.fix: write the superproject's folder name or the person's slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
